mission:
Riverside Park has hosted our markets, our kids' football and our summer nights for fifty years. A developer has offered the council a quick payday to build on it.

The council votes in March. A petition with thousands of local names is the clearest message councillors can get, and it shows them how many voters are watching.

Add your name, then share this page with three neighbours. Every signature counts.
